`MistralParser._legacy_extract_tool_calls` turns malformed model output into a 500.

Neither is caught on the way out:

- `chat_completion_full_generator` calls `parser.parse(...)` outside any `try`
- `Parser._extract_tool_calls` calls `self.extract_tool_calls(...)` outsid

title: [Bugfix] Break cached Hub metadata traceback cycles
body_opening:
- A transient Hugging Face Hub HEAD failure can return a cached file while its swallowed exception traceback retains the vLLM caller until cyclic GC.
- The vLLM Hub boundary now detaches the returned exception, cause, and context tracebacks before cached fallback completes.
- The fix is platform-independent and does not add `gc.collect()` or change successful download behavior.

## Motivation

The DSV4 indexer sizes its paged gather and its logits buffer from `MAX_SEQ_LEN_FOR_CAPTURE`, which is the **full configured context** — nothing about the request in hand. Graph capture freezes that width into the replayed graph, so at `--context-length 262144` a 128-token conversation performs full-context indexer work on every single decode step.

The width is read from the request-to-token pool, `deepseek_v4_backend.py`:

self._full_seq_len_for_capture = self.req_to_token.shape[1]
```

At the launch configuration used below (`--context-length 262144 --page-size 256`) that is **262148**, not 262144 — the pool is padded. Every decode step paid for all of it.
